# Troubleshooting

## Overview

This document provides solutions to common issues when using the SteamGuard.TOTP library.

## Common Issues

### 1. Generated Code Doesn't Work with Steam

**Symptoms**: Code generated by library is rejected by Steam.

**Causes & Solutions**:

| Cause | Solution |
|-------|----------|
| Wrong shared secret | Verify secret matches Steam mobile authenticator |
| Clock out of sync | Enable NTP: `timedatectl set-ntp true` (Linux) |
| Secret has whitespace | Trim secret: `secret.Trim()` |
| Wrong time step | Try adjacent time steps (±1) |

**Debug Steps**:
```csharp
// Check current time step
var provider = new TimeStepProvider();
long step = provider.GetCurrentTimeStep();
Console.WriteLine($"Time step: {step}");

// Generate codes for adjacent steps
for (long i = step - 1; i <= step + 1; i++)
{
    var fixedProvider = new FixedTimeStepProvider(i);
    var guard = new SteamGuard(fixedProvider);
    Console.WriteLine($"Step {i}: {guard.GenerateAuthenticationCode(secret)}");
}
```

### 2. ArgumentNullException

**Error**: `ArgumentNullException: Shared secret cannot be null. (Parameter 'sharedSecret')`

**Cause**: Passing `null` to `GenerateAuthenticationCode`.

**Solution**:
```csharp
// Check before calling
if (sharedSecret == null)
    throw new ArgumentException("Secret not configured");

string code = steamGuard.GenerateAuthenticationCode(sharedSecret);
```

### 3. ArgumentException (Empty)

**Error**: `ArgumentException: Shared secret cannot be empty. (Parameter 'sharedSecret')`

**Cause**: Passing empty string or whitespace-only string.

**Solution**:
```csharp
if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(sharedSecret))
    throw new ArgumentException("Secret not configured");

string code = steamGuard.GenerateAuthenticationCode(sharedSecret.Trim());
```

### 4. FormatException (Invalid Base32)

**Error**: `FormatException: Invalid Base32 string: contains invalid characters.`

**Cause**: Secret contains characters outside Base32 alphabet (A-Z, 2-7).

**Solution**:
```csharp
// Validate before calling
if (!SteamGuardValidator.IsValidSharedSecret(secret))
    throw new ArgumentException("Invalid secret format");

// Valid characters: ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ234567
```

### 5. Build Errors

#### NETSDK1045: Target Framework Not Found

**Error**: `The current .NET SDK does not support targeting .NET 10.0.`

**Solution**: Install .NET 10 SDK from https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download

#### NU1101: Package Not Found

**Error**: `Unable to find package NuciExtensions.`

**Solution**:
```bash
dotnet restore
# Or
dotnet add package NuciExtensions --version 5.3.1
```

#### CS0246: Type Not Found

**Error**: `The type or namespace name 'SteamGuard' could not be found.`

**Solution**:
```csharp
// Add using directive
using SteamGuard.TOTP;
```

### 6. Test Failures

#### Time-Dependent Tests Flaky

**Symptom**: Tests pass/fail depending on when run.

**Solution**: Use `FixedTimeStepProvider` for all tests:
```csharp
[Test]
public void MyTest()
{
    var provider = new FixedTimeStepProvider(55752480); // Fixed time
    var guard = new SteamGuard(provider);
    // ...
}
```

#### Test Discovery Fails

**Error**: `No test matches the given testcase filter.`

**Solution**:
```bash
# Ensure test adapter installed
dotnet add package NUnit3TestAdapter --version 6.2.0

# Run with explicit filter
dotnet test --filter "FullyQualifiedName~SteamGuardTests"
```

## Platform-Specific Issues

### Linux

**Issue**: `System.DllNotFoundException: libcrypto`

**Solution**: Install OpenSSL:
```bash
# Ubuntu/Debian
sudo apt-get install libssl3

# RHEL/Fedora
sudo dnf install openssl-libs
```

### Docker

**Issue**: Codes don't work in container.

**Solution**: Ensure time synchronization:
```dockerfile
# Add to Dockerfile
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y ntpdate && \
    ntpdate -s pool.ntp.org
```

### Windows

**Issue**: Time zone issues.

**Solution**: Library uses UTC, but verify:
```csharp
// Force UTC
var provider = new TimeStepProvider();
// Internally uses DateTime.UtcNow via NuciExtensions
```

## Performance Issues

### High Allocation

**Symptom**: Gen 0 collections spike.

**Analysis**: Each call allocates ~200-500 bytes. This is normal.

**Optimization**: Reuse `SteamGuard` instance:
```csharp
// Good: Single instance
var steamGuard = new SteamGuard();
for (int i = 0; i < 1000; i++)
{
    string code = steamGuard.GenerateAuthenticationCode(secret);
}

// Avoid: Creating new instance each time
for (int i = 0; i < 1000; i++)
{
    var guard = new SteamGuard(); // Allocates
    string code = guard.GenerateAuthenticationCode(secret);
}
```

## Debugging Tips

### Enable Detailed Logging

```csharp
// Wrap with logging
public class DebugSteamGuard : ISteamGuard
{
    private readonly ISteamGuard _inner;

    public string GenerateAuthenticationCode(string sharedSecret)
    {
        Console.WriteLine($"Input secret length: {sharedSecret?.Length}");
        Console.WriteLine($"Input secret (masked): {sharedSecret?[..2]}***{sharedSecret[^2..]}");
        
        string code = _inner.GenerateAuthenticationCode(sharedSecret);
        
        Console.WriteLine($"Output code: {code}");
        return code;
    }
}
```

### Inspect Intermediate Values

```csharp
// For debugging, replicate internal steps
public static void DebugGeneration(string secret, long timeStep)
{
    // 1. Decode Base32
    byte[] key = Base32Decode(secret);
    Console.WriteLine($"Key: {BitConverter.ToString(key)}");
    
    // 2. Time step bytes
    byte[] timeBytes = BitConverter.GetBytes(IPAddress.HostToNetworkOrder(timeStep));
    Console.WriteLine($"Time bytes: {BitConverter.ToString(timeBytes)}");
    
    // 3. HMAC-SHA1
    using var hmac = new HMACSHA1(key);
    byte[] hash = hmac.ComputeHash(timeBytes);
    Console.WriteLine($"Hash: {BitConverter.ToString(hash)}");
    
    // 4. Truncation
    int offset = hash[19] & 0xF;
    int binary = (hash[offset] & 0x7F) << 24 | 
                 (hash[offset + 1] & 0xFF) << 16 | 
                 (hash[offset + 2] & 0xFF) << 8 | 
                 (hash[offset + 3] & 0xFF);
    Console.WriteLine($"Binary: {binary}");
    
    // 5. Modulo
    int codeNum = binary % 10000000;
    Console.WriteLine($"Code num: {codeNum}");
    
    // 6. Alphabet mapping
    const string alphabet = "23456789BCDFGHJKMNPQRTVWXY";
    string code = "";
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++)
    {
        code = alphabet[codeNum % alphabet.Length] + code;
        codeNum /= alphabet.Length;
    }
    Console.WriteLine($"Final code: {code}");
}
```
